t: A palm-sized robot dog that walks, listens to voice commands, and learns tricks.
steps: Buy Bittle X from the Petoi store, either as a kit or pre-assembled.
Get a 5 V USB charger and charge the battery. The box has no charger.
Assemble the kit with the Petoi docs, or unpack the pre-assembled dog.
Install the Petoi app on a phone or computer.
Run joint calibration in the app to set each leg straight.
Try the built-in skills and a few voice commands.
Open Petoi Coding Blocks and build your first short dance.
meta: Open Code. From $104. A few stores.
